description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalHelpers module, verifying decision parsing, allowlist pattern matching, validation logic, and policy requirement checks.

classes.name: ExecApprovalHelpersTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for verifying the correctness of ExecApprovalHelpers functions.

methods.name: `parse decision trims and rejects invalid`
methods.description: Test function verifying that parseDecision correctly interprets various input strings and rejects invalid inputs.

methods.name: `allowlist pattern prefers resolution`
methods.description: Test function ensuring allowlistPattern chooses the resolved path when available, falling back correctly otherwise.

methods.name: `validate allowlist pattern returns reasons`
methods.description: Test function checking validation logic for allowlist patterns, including empty and basename-only patterns.

methods.name: `requires ask matches policy`
methods.description: Test function verifying the logic determining whether user prompts are required based on policies and allowlist entries.
